info.title: Media Platform API
info.description: REST API for authentication, media storage and delivery, dual-currency plans, quota metering, manual payments, SSLCOMMERZ checkout and paid subscription renewals.

BearerAuth.description: Use a user access token or scoped API key.

imgUrl.description: Stable public image URL. Null for private or non-image assets.

thumbnailUrl.description: Available after the thumbnail variant is READY.

previewUrl.description: Available after the preview variant is READY.

post.summary: Sign in and receive an access token

delete.summary: Delete account when ownership rules allow

post.summary: Change password and revoke other sessions

filename.description: Original client filename. `originalFilename` remains accepted as a compatibility alias.

visibility.description: Set PUBLIC to receive a stable imgUrl/fileUrl after completion. Omitted visibility remains PRIVATE.

put.description: Send application/octet-stream body. Default chunk size is 8 MB.

post.summary: Complete an upload and return stable CDN URL fields

get.description: Each asset includes fileUrl, imgUrl, thumbnailUrl and previewUrl fields according to visibility and variant readiness.
The response includes stable CDN URL fields. imgUrl is non-null only for a READY PUBLIC image.

patch.description: The response includes stable CDN URL fields. imgUrl is non-null only for a READY PUBLIC image.
